test.title: 奢华8K国家美食广告
test.type: 直接生图/参考编辑提示词
test.test_input: 国家=China；菜品=Chinese steamed pork bao buns；食物类型=steamed stuffed bun；背景=deep jade green；画幅4:3，两种摄影变化。
test.adaptation: ChatGPT适配测试，非原指定模型实测
changes: 仅替换原文国家、菜品、类型、背景色和画幅变量。
多视觉版本需求用两张独立图执行，不添加原文未要求的宫格。
无参考图的两次文生图共用同一组变量；不测试同一实物的身份一致性。
test.selected_source_prompt:
Ultra-high-quality, hyper-realistic commercial food photography of Chinese steamed pork bao buns, rendered in 8K detail with a 4:3 aspect ratio.

The food is shown in multiple premium visual variations, each highlighting texture, layers, and freshness in a cinematic way.

Food details:
– Authentic Chinese cuisine presentation
– Clearly visible layers, fillings, or structure specific to steamed stuffed pork bun
– Rich, natural colors and realistic textures

Motion & drama:
– Subtle mid-air elements (crumbs, ingredients, sauce, or spices)
– Natural gravity realism, frozen motion
– No mess, clean and controlled composition

Lighting & camera:
– Controlled studio lighting emphasizing texture and shine
– High-speed photography look
– Shallow to medium depth of field

Background:
– Solid or soft gradient background in deep jade green
– Clean, seamless, distraction-free

Style & finish:
– Luxury food advertising aesthetic
– Rich contrast, warm natural tones
– Ultra-sharp focus, no artificial glow

Negative prompt:
Text, logos, branding, hands, people, utensils, plates, tables, cartoon style, burnt food, overexposure, low-detail textures, artificial shine.
